input.summary: Implemented an in-memory Task Management API in TypeScript using Node.js built-in http module. Files added: event bus, UserService, ProjectService, TaskService, CommentService, NotificationService, Router, main server entry, and demo script. Services communicate via EventBus; NotificationService subscribes to task and comment events. API routes implemented per spec. Demo script exercises creating users, project, members, task creation/assignment/comment/status changes and notification retrieval. Project compiles with TypeScript (tsc --noEmit successful).
